description: List tradable perpetual symbols for one exchange. No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval). query_candles and calculate_indicator may require x402 USDC payment when enabled — invalid args are rejected before payment, and a tool error is never settled, so it costs nothing. Returns { exchange, market_type, symbols[], count } — the exact symbols query_candles and calculate_indicator accept.
name: get_available_pairs
title: Get Available Pairs
